taskPacket.objective: Add the regression test that fails whenever a harness adapter reads an environment variable name it did not declare, covering all seven adapters and the catalogue that exposes their declarations.
instructions: Add the regression test that fails whenever a harness adapter reads an environment variable name it did not declare, covering all seven adapters and the catalogue that exposes their declarations.

argv: --test-name-pattern=every harness adapter declares the environment it reads

definitionOfDone.text: A test named every harness adapter declares the environment it reads passes when every adapter declares what it reads and fails when an undeclared read is introduced.

proof.ref: node --test --test-name-pattern="every harness adapter declares the environment it reads" test/harnesses/declared-env.test.mjs
